text: The Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II – Papua New Guinea Country Program (BSRP II – PNG) is a national initiative under a broader regional effort led by The Pacific Community (SPC) and funded by the European Union. It aims to reduce disaster and climate risks in Papua New Guinea by addressing governance gaps, enhancing early warning systems, upgrading seismic networks, improving data management for vulnerable populations, and integrating disaster risk management into school curricula.
